latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of For Beginners Editor Online — AI-powered video editing for beginners.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM videos up to 500MB for automatic, AI-assisted editing in minutes.
- Describe editing tasks (trim, add transitions, titles) in plain language—no complex software skills needed.
- Connects to a cloud backend; handles session setup and anonymous token creation automatically.
- Supports export to 1080p MP4 and other popular formats.
- Simple commands for checking credits/balance, session status, uploading, and exporting finished videos.
- Shows clear progress updates and handles common errors (token, session, file type, export, limits).
